question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A sound that cannot be heard
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Inaudible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given group of words** "A sound that cannot be heard"** refers to any sound that is not loud enough to be heard by human ears. 
 
• The correct term for this is **"Inaudible", **which means unable to be heard.(अश्रव्य).

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'Inaudible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Audacious'** refers to a willingness to take bold risks.(साहसिक).
 
• **'Autonomous'** refers to something that has the freedom to govern itself or control its own affairs.(स्वयत्त).
 
• **'Delible' **refers to something that can be deleted or erased.(मिटाने योग्य).
